Lesson: key distinguishing feature: the crime is "过失投放危险物质" because the act is negligent disposal/placement of hazardous substance, not just negligent homicide. It involves placing dangerous substance in public place leading to poisoning. Different from "过失致人死亡" which requires negligent act causing death without dangerous substance element. Rule: if the conduct is negligent handling/placing of a hazardous material that causes poisoning, label as 过失投放危险物质. Provide in Chinese.
